messages:
Alice Chen: Quick FYI — deploying svc-search v2.4.0 to prod tonight. Window starts 22:00 UTC, expected finish ~22:40 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if healthy. Freeze window: 21:45-23:30 UTC (no non-urgent infra changes).
Bob Patel: acked, I'll be primary watcher for the canary and smoke checks. I'll post progress updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
Carol Nguyen: FYI I'm on a short call 22:30-23:05 but will keep pager on. If you need a rollback during that span, tag me and also ping Dan.
Dan Rivera: I'll be secondary watcher and can initiate rollback if we see error spike >1% or latency p50 jump >200ms. Quick checklist I ran locally — load tests at expected qps look fine.
Alice Chen: Risk notes: we're migrating a small portion of KV cache keys to a new namespace as part of this release. Most traffic won't hit the migration path, but there's a chance of cache warmup causing transient 5xxs for long-sequence generation flows. Keep an eye on /generate latency and 5xx rate.
Erin Lopez: Can we get a CR ping for the change that touches routing? I want to scan for edge cases. @Alice Chen can you drop the PR link?
Alice Chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/svc-search/pull/718 — includes routing fallback and KV migration scripts. Please skim for callback timeouts and circuit-breaker config.
Bob Patel: Deploy bot schedule:
deploy-bot: "Starting rollout: svc-search v2.4.0 — Canary 5% at 22:00 UTC" (link: https://deploys.redwood/rollout/2581)
Bob Patel: Smoke checklist for watchers:
1) health endpoints: curl -sS https://prod.redwood/api/health | jq .status (should be OK)
2) sample gen: curl -X POST https://prod.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .status (expect 200, latency < 500ms)
3) error dashboard: dashboards.redwood.com/d/errors?q=svc:search (monitor 5xx rate and error messages)
4) kv-migration metric: prod.kv.migration.inflight (should be < 50)
(Commands for quick run)
```sh
# health
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://prod.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# sample gen
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://prod.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
# pod logs
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=svc-search --tail=200
```
Carol Nguyen: Noted. Also leaving a note: if we see KV migration errors (KeyMismatch or TTL issues), don't escalate immediately to infra — try a targeted retry via the migration helper script first. I posted the helper in the PR.
Dan Rivera: If anyone sees unexpected traffic routing to eu-west when the rollout is in us-east, that's a config bug — immediately set canary to 0% and tag me.
Erin Lopez: scanning PR now, will reply inline with any concerns before 21:30 UTC.
Bob Patel: small ops request — please avoid any non-critical prod deploys in the freeze window. If you must, loop in the oncall channel and get explicit ack from both watchers.
Alice Chen: thanks team. I'll start the canary at 22:00 and post status updates (canary started, canary healthy, ramping to 25%, full rollout). If you see anything odd call me or DM.
Bob Patel: ack — will post first smoke at +5m.
Carol Nguyen: (reacted :eyes:)
Erin Lopez: acked.
deploy-bot: "Canary started: 5% -> deployment id 2581-canary"
Bob Patel: first smoke @22:05: health OK, sample gen 220ms p50, 0.2% 5xx (baseline 0.1%). Watching for trend.
Dan Rivera: noted. If 5xx climbs above 0.8% sustained for 5m, prepare rollback.
Alice Chen: thanks — will keep this thread updated.
